title: BGISEQ-500 WGS Library Construction
author: Jie Huang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ps5dng6

steps.title: Assess DNA quality
steps.instruction: Confirm genomic DNA is high‑quality (free of salts/organics) and shows an intact band >23 kb on a 1 % agarose gel or by Agilent 2100 BioAnalyzer.

steps.title: Fragment DNA with Covaris
steps.instruction: Fragment the genomic DNA using a Covaris focused‑ultrasonicator according to the instrument’s protocol. Optimize conditions beforehand and verify fragment size by agarose electrophoresis or BioAnalyzer.

steps.title: First AMPure bead cleanup
steps.instruction: Perform bead‑based size selection on the sheared DNA. Use the volumes appropriate for your read length (PE100, PE50 or PE150) as listed below.

substeps.instruction: Place AMPure XP beads at room temperature for 30 min and fully thaw.
For PE100: add 48 µL beads to 80 µL sheared DNA; for PE50: add 80 µL beads; for PE150: add 44 µL beads. Mix gently by pipetting 10×, incubate 5 min RT.
Briefly centrifuge, place tube on magnetic stand for 2 min until liquid clears, transfer supernatant to a new tube.
For PE100: add 16 µL beads to 128 µL supernatant; for PE50: add 40 µL beads to 160 µL supernatant; for PE150: add 12 µL beads to 124 µL supernatant. Mix 10×, incubate 5 min RT.
Magnet 2 min, discard supernatant, add 500 µL fresh 80 % ethanol while on magnet, rotate tube half‑turn 4×, wait 1 min, discard ethanol. Repeat ethanol wash once.
Leave tube on magnet, dry at room temperature for 3 min.
Remove tube from magnet, add 46 µL TE (or 32 µL TE for later clean‑ups), mix, incubate 5 min RT, magnet 2 min, transfer eluate (44 µL or 32 µL) to a new 0.2 mL PCR tube or store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Quantify and dilute DNA
steps.instruction: Quantify the purified DNA with a Qubit dsDNA HS Assay Kit or Quant‑iT PicoGreen dsDNA Assay Kit. Remove 50 ng (based on concentration) into a new 0.2 mL PCR tube and add nuclease‑free water to a final volume of 40 µL.

steps.title: Prepare ERAT reaction
steps.instruction: In the same PCR tube, add the ERAT buffer and enzyme (as supplied), mix gently by pipetting (do not vortex), briefly centrifuge to collect liquid, and run in a thermal cycler for 45 min according to the supplied program.

steps.title: Adapter ligation
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL Adapter Mix to the reaction tube and mix gently. Prepare the ligation mixture (Ligation Buffer II is viscous – pipette slowly) and add 25 µL of this mixture to the tube. Run the ligation in a thermal cycler for 30 min (program as supplied). After ligation, add 20 µL TE to bring the volume to 100 µL, then transfer the entire volume to a non‑stick tube containing 50 µL room‑temperature AMPure XP beads and mix slowly 10 times to avoid bubbles.

steps.title: Post‑ligation bead cleanup
steps.instruction: Clean up the ligation product with AMPure beads as follows:

substeps.instruction: Incubate the bead/DNA mixture 5 min at room temperature.
Place tube on magnetic stand for 2 min, discard supernatant.
Add 500 µL fresh 80 % ethanol while on magnet, rotate half‑turn 4×, wait 1 min, discard ethanol. Repeat ethanol wash once.
Leave on magnet, dry 3 min at room temperature.
Remove from magnet, add 46 µL TE, mix, incubate 5 min RT.
Magnet 2 min, transfer 44 µL supernatant to a new 0.2 mL PCR tube (or store at –20 °C).

steps.title: PCR amplification
steps.instruction: Place the tube in a thermal cycler and run the PCR program for 15 min 50 s (00:15:50) as supplied with the kit.

steps.title: Post‑PCR bead cleanup
steps.instruction: Purify the PCR product with AMPure XP beads:

substeps.instruction: Pre‑warm AMPure XP beads at room temperature for 30 min and vortex to mix.
Add 100 µL beads to 100 µL PCR product, mix 10 times, incubate 5 min RT.
Magnet 2 min, discard supernatant.
Add 500 µL 80 % ethanol, rotate half‑turn 4×, wait 1 min, discard ethanol. Repeat ethanol wash once.
Leave on magnet, dry 3 min RT.
Remove from magnet, add 32 µL TE, mix, incubate 5 min RT.
Magnet 2 min, transfer eluate to a new non‑stick tube (store at –20 °C).

steps.title: Quantify final library
steps.instruction: Quantify the purified library with a Qubit dsDNA HS or PicoGreen assay. Optionally pool samples with different barcodes. Add the calculated amount of library to a PCR tube and bring the volume to 48 µL with nuclease‑free water.

steps.title: Denature library DNA
steps.instruction: Denature the library by heating at 95 °C for 3 min, then immediately place on ice.

steps.title: Prepare splint ligation mix
steps.instruction: On ice, prepare the splint (or ligation) reaction mixture as supplied. Add 11.8 µL of this mixture to the 48 µL denatured DNA, mix gently, and run in a thermal cycler for 3 min (00:03:00) according to the provided program.

steps.title: Circularization digestion
steps.instruction: Prepare the digestion reaction solution on ice. After the circularization step, add 4 µL digestion solution to the circularized DNA, mix, briefly centrifuge, and run in a thermal cycler for 30 min (00:30:00). Then add 7.5 µL Digestion Stop Buffer, mix to terminate the reaction, and transfer the mixture to a new non‑stick tube for purification.

steps.title: Final bead cleanup
steps.instruction: Perform a final AMPure XP bead purification of the digested product:

substeps.instruction: Place AMPure XP beads at room temperature for 30 min and vortex.
Add 168 µL beads to the digestion product, mix 10 times, incubate 10 min RT.
Magnet 2 min, discard supernatant.
Add 500 µL 80 % ethanol, rotate half‑turn 4×, wait 1 min, discard ethanol. Repeat ethanol wash once.
Leave on magnet, dry 3 min RT.
Remove from magnet, add 32 µL TE, mix, incubate 10 min RT.
Magnet 2 min, transfer supernatant to a new tube and store at –20 °C, ready for DNB preparation.
